line-drawing.label: Line drawing
line-drawing.description: Drawn lines carry the figure, and color stays light and local

drafting-and-flat.label: Drafting and flat
drafting-and-flat.description: Exact geometry and flat areas carry the figure

painting-and-print.label: Painting and print
painting-and-print.description: A painted or printed surface gives the figure its feel

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.description: Playful materials make the figure approachable

dimensional.label: Dimensional
dimensional.description: Built objects with depth, seen as small models, carry the figure

notebook-and-archive.label: Notebook and archive
notebook-and-archive.description: Paper records, from a notebook page to an old printed drawing, carry the figure

ink-and-print.label: Ink and print
ink-and-print.description: Brush ink and hand printmaking give the figure its texture

signs-and-screens.label: Signs and screens
signs-and-screens.description: The plain visual language of signs, transit maps, and text screens carries the figure

handdraft.label: Hand-drafted technical sketch
handdraft.line: Clear black pen with a light wobble for outlines, dividers, and arrows; neither bolder marker strokes than the letters nor mechanical hairlines
handdraft.fill: Light teal, orange, and gray hatching, only on the fields, ranges, and amounts that carry meaning
handdraft.background: Plain white, with no paper color or shadow
handdraft.lettering: Dark black, rounded natural handwriting, with numbers large enough to read when the figure is shrunk

pen-technical.label: Pen technical illustration
pen-technical.line: Thin to medium black pen with a natural wobble, rubbing, and changes of pressure, keeping a black core in the main outlines, letters, and arrows
pen-technical.fill: Partial teal and orange colored-pencil rubs, with short gray hatching in places
pen-technical.lettering: Natural handwriting placed beside or under the objects, never boxed in labels or speech bubbles
suits: concrete objects such as documents and keys

pencil-sketch.label: Pencil sketch
pencil-sketch.line: Soft gray graphite, with faint construction lines left visible and darker, firmer strokes on the final outlines
pencil-sketch.fill: Graphite shading and smudged tone, with no color or one faint wash of a single accent
pencil-sketch.background: Off-white drawing paper with a fine tooth
pencil-sketch.lettering: Small pencil block capitals and cursive notes, slightly uneven

chalkboard.label: Chalkboard
chalkboard.line: White chalk strokes with broken, dusty edges, and arrows drawn in one quick motion
chalkboard.fill: Pale yellow, pink, and light blue chalk rubbed on with the side of the stick
chalkboard.background: Dark green-black slate with faint smears of erased writing
chalkboard.lettering: Large upright chalk print, as a teacher writes it, with underlines for emphasis

flat-vector.label: Flat vector
flat-vector.line: No outlines, or uniform thin lines in one dark color, around shapes built from clean geometric primitives with rounded corners
flat-vector.fill: Solid flat colors from a palette of four or five hues; never a gradient anywhere, not even a light one in a header band or an icon, and no texture or shadow
flat-vector.background: A solid light color or plain white
flat-vector.lettering: A clean geometric sans-serif of medium weight, aligned to a grid

blueprint.label: Blueprint
blueprint.line: Thin white and pale cyan drafting lines of even width, with dimension lines, center lines, and dashed hidden edges
blueprint.fill: No fill; areas told apart by fine white cross-hatching or dotted grids
blueprint.background: Deep Prussian blue with a faint square grid
blueprint.lettering: White technical stencil capitals, with small callouts on leader lines

isometric.label: Isometric
isometric.line: Crisp lines in a true 30-degree isometric projection, every edge parallel to one of the three axes; never an oblique view, in which a front face is drawn flat and the depth recedes at an angle
isometric.fill: Three flat tones on each object, light on top, medium on the left, and dark on the right, from a cool palette
isometric.background: Plain white or very light gray, with no horizon
isometric.lettering: Small upright sans-serif labels on leader lines, never skewed along the faces

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.line: Thin black lines of a single weight, used sparingly, with alignment and space doing the work of boxes
minimal.fill: White, with one accent color used in one place only, on the single thing that matters; never put the accent color in a second place
minimal.lettering: A light sans-serif in two sizes only, in black and gray
suits: relations between two or three things

watercolor.label: Watercolor
watercolor.line: Loose sepia ink lines under the paint, broken where the wash takes over
watercolor.fill: Transparent watercolor washes with soft blooms and hard drying edges, bleeding a little past the lines
watercolor.background: Warm white cold-press watercolor paper with visible grain
watercolor.lettering: Calm, small hand lettering in fine ink
suits: concepts with a mood such as growth or calm

newsprint.label: Newsprint
newsprint.line: Charcoal engraved contours with a slight spread of ink, as on a cheap press run
newsprint.fill: Coarse black halftone with one restrained muted-teal spot ink, slightly out of register
newsprint.background: Flat warm-cream newsprint with subtle paper pores
newsprint.lettering: Condensed headline type with dry-brush wear, and small serif captions

woodblock.label: Woodblock print
woodblock.line: Bold carved outlines that taper and break, with chisel marks at their ends
woodblock.fill: Flat areas of indigo, vermilion, and ochre printed with visible wood grain and uneven ink
woodblock.background: Warm handmade paper with visible fibers
woodblock.lettering: Carved block lettering set inside cartouches

retro-poster.label: Retro poster
retro-poster.line: Clean bold shapes with thick outlines or none, as on a mid-century travel poster
retro-poster.fill: Three to five flat screen-printed colors such as mustard, teal, coral, and cream, with grain and slight overprint
retro-poster.background: Cream paper with a subtle texture, sometimes behind a sunburst
retro-poster.lettering: Large rounded display type with small geometric captions

whiteboard.label: Whiteboard and sticky notes
whiteboard.line: Black, blue, and red marker strokes of even width with rounded ends, and hand-drawn arrows
whiteboard.fill: Square sticky notes in yellow, pink, green, and blue, slightly rotated, with small shadows
whiteboard.background: A glossy whiteboard with faint ghosts of erased marks

comic-panel.label: Comic panels
comic-panel.line: Inked black outlines of varying weight, with speed lines and panel borders
comic-panel.fill: Bright flat colors with cel shading and occasional halftone dots
comic-panel.background: Panels separated by white gutters; never add decoration unrelated to the content, such as clouds, sparkles, or effect bursts that explain nothing
comic-panel.lettering: All-capital comic lettering inside speech balloons and caption boxes

pixel-art.label: Pixel art
pixel-art.line: Hard one-pixel outlines on a coarse, visible pixel grid, without smoothing
pixel-art.fill: A limited palette of about sixteen colors, with dithering for shading
pixel-art.background: A flat dark or light color, sometimes a simple tiled pattern
pixel-art.lettering: A blocky bitmap font in capitals
suits: simple processes in a playful tone

clay.label: Clay model
clay.line: No drawn lines; edges come from soft, rounded forms molded in clay
clay.fill: Matte pastel modeling clay with fingerprints, lit as small three-dimensional objects with soft studio shadows
clay.background: A smooth single-color backdrop, gently lit
clay.lettering: Rounded friendly labels printed on small cards set beside the objects

low-poly.label: Low poly
low-poly.line: No outlines; every form is built from flat triangular facets that meet at sharp edges, with no more facets than the shape needs
low-poly.fill: Each facet one flat tone from a muted palette, lighter on the faces turned to a single light at the upper left and darker away from it, never shaded within a facet
low-poly.background: A plain pale gray backdrop with a flat faceted ground plane under the objects
low-poly.lettering: A bold sans-serif in dark gray on small flat label plates beside the objects, never wrapped onto the facets
suits: systems shown as objects in space
amounts shown as height or volume

papercraft.label: Papercraft
papercraft.line: No drawn lines; edges come from cut and folded colored paper, with crisp fold creases and slightly uneven scissor cuts
papercraft.fill: Matte colored card in four to six colors, layered so that each sheet casts a small soft shadow on the sheet below
papercraft.background: A sheet of plain light card, lit evenly from above
papercraft.lettering: Rounded sans-serif letters printed on paper tabs or cut out of paper and glued beside the objects

diorama.label: Diorama
diorama.line: No drawn outlines; scale-model objects with modeled edges stand on a small cut-away base, seen from slightly above
diorama.fill: Painted miniature materials such as wood, stone, grass, and metal, with a small contact shadow under every object
diorama.background: A neutral studio backdrop around the base, with the cut edge of the base showing its layers of soil or floor
diorama.lettering: Small signposts and placards standing on the base, with clear printed sans-serif letters
suits: scenes with several actors at once
where each part of a system runs
physical workflows such as a warehouse or a factory

toy-blocks.label: Toy blocks
toy-blocks.line: No drawn lines; shapes are put together from interlocking plastic toy blocks with round studs on top, every block aligned to the block grid
toy-blocks.fill: Smooth plastic in red, yellow, blue, green, and white, with a small highlight on each stud and no texture
toy-blocks.background: A plain light gray base plate seen from above at an angle
toy-blocks.lettering: Chunky rounded capitals printed on flat tiles laid on the blocks

notebook-doodle.label: Notebook doodle
notebook-doodle.line: Blue ballpoint pen lines drawn quickly, with loops, retraced arrows, and small scribbles at the corners
notebook-doodle.fill: Mostly unfilled; a few areas shaded by ballpoint hatching, and one yellow highlighter stroke over the key word
notebook-doodle.background: A ruled notebook page with faint blue lines and a red margin line on the left
notebook-doodle.lettering: Casual lowercase handwriting in ballpoint, with circled words and double underlines

grid-memo.label: Grid design memo
grid-memo.line: Fine black technical pen lines snapped to the grid, with right angles, short dimension ticks, and boxed numbers
grid-memo.fill: No color fill; regions marked by one light gray marker tone and a few red pen check marks
grid-memo.background: Graph paper with a pale blue square grid and a darker line every ten squares
grid-memo.lettering: Small, neat engineering capitals aligned to the grid lines

patent-drawing.label: Patent drawing
patent-drawing.line: Uniform thin black ink lines as in a patent figure, with a numbered leader line to each part and broken lines for hidden parts
patent-drawing.fill: No color or tone; surfaces shown only by parallel shading lines on the side away from the light
patent-drawing.background: Plain white paper with a wide margin and a figure label under the drawing
patent-drawing.lettering: Serif reference numerals at the ends of the leader lines, explained in a short numbered legend under the figure

old-map.label: Old map
old-map.line: Brown ink lines drawn with a dip pen, with hatched coastlines, dotted routes, and a small compass rose
old-map.fill: Faded watercolor tints of ochre, sage green, and pale blue, laid unevenly inside the borders
old-map.background: Aged parchment with stains, brown spots, and darkened edges
old-map.lettering: Hand-lettered serif capitals for regions and italic script for smaller places, curving along the features
suits: where things are in a large system

sumi-e.label: Ink wash
sumi-e.line: Black brush strokes that change width from a thick press to a fine dry tip, each object drawn in as few strokes as possible
sumi-e.fill: Gray ink washes in three or four dilutions, with one small red stamp as the only color
sumi-e.background: Off-white rice paper with soft fibers and wide empty space
sumi-e.lettering: Brush-written letters in black ink, set in a short vertical or horizontal column
suits: a single concept with a mood
relations between two or three things

risograph.label: Risograph
risograph.line: Bold shapes defined by the edges between ink layers rather than outlines, with the colors slightly out of register
risograph.fill: Two or three flat spot inks such as bright pink, teal, and yellow, with coarse grain and a darker third color where two inks overlap
risograph.background: Uncoated off-white paper with a light speckle
risograph.lettering: Chunky grotesque sans-serif letters printed in one spot ink

copperplate.label: Copperplate engraving
copperplate.line: Fine engraved lines that swell and taper, with dense cross-hatching for shadow and stippled dots for soft forms
copperplate.fill: No flat color; every tone is built from the density of lines in black or deep sepia ink
copperplate.background: Cream laid paper with a faint plate mark around the image
copperplate.lettering: Engraved script for titles and small roman capitals for labels

paper-cut.label: Paper cut
paper-cut.line: Silhouettes cut from a single sheet with a craft knife, every shape held by thin bridges, with no drawn lines
paper-cut.fill: One solid color for the cut sheet, usually black or red, with no shading
paper-cut.background: A plain sheet of a contrasting color behind the cut paper, showing through the openings
paper-cut.lettering: Letters cut out of the same sheet in simple bold shapes, joined to the border

pictogram.label: Pictogram
pictogram.line: Simplified people and objects built from geometric shapes with one uniform stroke and rounded joins, as on public signs
pictogram.fill: One dark color on white, or white on one dark color, with a single signal color such as safety orange for the key element
pictogram.background: A plain white field, or square sign panels with rounded corners
pictogram.lettering: A plain upright sans-serif of medium weight, with a short word under each pictogram
suits: explanations for readers of many languages

metro-map.label: Metro map
metro-map.line: Thick colored lines that run only horizontally, vertically, or at 45 degrees, with rounded bends and short white ticks for stations
metro-map.fill: One flat distinct color for each line, white circles for stations, and white rings with black outlines for interchanges
metro-map.background: Plain white or very pale gray, with water or zones as flat pale tints when they are needed
metro-map.lettering: A clear humanist sans-serif set horizontally beside each station, never along the line

terminal-screen.label: Terminal screen
terminal-screen.line: Text-mode boxes drawn with single and double line characters, and arrows made of characters, everything on a fixed character grid
terminal-screen.fill: Green or amber characters on a dark screen, with one inverse block for the selected item, and no shading or glow around the text
terminal-screen.background: A dark charcoal terminal window with a thin title bar
terminal-screen.lettering: One monospaced font in one size throughout, with a solid cursor block at the end of the prompt

sticker.label: Sticker
sticker.line: Bold dark outlines around simple cartoon objects, each wrapped in a thick white die-cut border
sticker.fill: Bright flat colors with one hard-edged highlight shape on each object and a small offset shadow under each sticker
sticker.background: A plain mid-gray or kraft paper surface, with the stickers slightly overlapping
sticker.lettering: Rounded heavy display letters with their own white border, set on a sticker of their own
